caseName: Fay v. United States ex rel. Marcial
caseNameFull: Fay, Warden v. United States ex rel. Marcial, alias Johnson
attorneys: Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, John R. Davison, Solicitor General, Samuel A. Hirshowitz, First Assistant Attorney General, Michael Freyberg, Assistant Attorney General, and George K. Bernstein, Deputy Assistant Attorney General, for petitioner. Respondent pro se.

opinions.text: Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
